Orissa High Court Seeks BCCI Response on Delayed OCA Polls

The Orissa High Court has requested a response from the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) regarding the delay in the elections of the Odisha Cricket Association (OCA). The court is seeking the BCCI's stance on the matter. The specific details of the court's order and the reasons for the delay were not provided in the coverage.
